svg.text: K11 Hatch on the bench: serving and dish return
The well lid is the bench and the hatch: plates go out and dirty dishes come back behind a motorised sliding glass door.
bench 540 × 460 = 0.25 m² · 150 W heater mat 40–60 °C
door: NEMA 17 + GT2 belt, current-limited, soft edge
2 plates side by side · persons 3–4: a second cycle
FRONT VIEW (as the diner sees it)
tool cabinet
OVEN (plate warming)
4-zone hob (cold during serving)
WELL below
door motor + belt
TOP VIEW (bench level; diner at the bottom)
mast lane
2 bench trays
opening
door parks here (in front of the hob)
DINER
BENCH RULES (the bench is time-shared: prep, plating, hatch, dish return, well lid)
B-1 food never touches the bench top: raw only in GN on a bench tray; that tray goes to the well before plating
B-2 the well lid opens only with the bench cleared (≤ 5 min per load change); the hatch shows "busy"
B-3 serving: two plates at the bench front, door opens, the diner takes them; repeated for persons 3–4
B-4 return: carrier and glass/cutlery basket first; door closes after; carriers wait for the running load
B-5 the heater mat runs only for warm-holding and plate warming, never during prep
SRV-009 (≤ 3 min) holds if the first pair is taken; SRV-014 becomes marginal (K11 section 4).

g.text: 1/8 Two warm plates set at the bench front and plated; the heater mat under the bench keeps them at 40–60 °C.
2/8 The hand withdraws to the rear; the glass door slides left in front of the hob (current-limited, soft edge).
3/8 The diner takes the two plates out through the opening.
4/8 The door closes. For persons 3–4 the same cycle runs a second time.
5/8 After the meal the hand sets a plate carrier and the glass/cutlery basket on the bench.
6/8 The door opens; the diners put the dirty dishes in; the door closes again.
7/8 When the running well load ends, the hand parks carrier and basket on the cold hob.
8/8 Bench cleared: the bench (= well lid) lifts and the well is loaded; the hatch shows "busy".
